question: Which of the following players won the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in Hockey in 2021?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**PR Sreejesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PR Sreejesh** is a celebrated Indian hockey player who played as a **goalkeeper** for the Indian men's hockey team.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in **2021**, which is India's highest sporting honor.
 
• The award recognizes his **exceptional performance** and contribution to Indian hockey, particularly during the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• At the Tokyo Olympics, PR Sreejesh played a crucial role in helping India win a **historic bronze medal** in hockey, marking India's return to the Olympic podium after 41 years.
 
• Sreejesh has been a vital part of the Indian hockey team since **2006** and has participated in multiple international tournaments, earning accolades for his **goalkeeping skills and leadership**.
 
• He hails from **Kerala** and is widely regarded as one of the finest hockey goalkeepers in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain**__

 __
 
• Lovlina Borgohain is an Indian boxer who specializes in the **women's welterweight category.**
 
• She won a **bronze medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics** in boxing, making her the third Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal.
 
• Lovlina hails from the **state of Assam** and has received the **Arjuna Award** for her achievements.
 
 
 
• **Sumit Antil**__
 __
 
• Sumit Antil is an Indian para-athlete who competes in **javelin throw.**
 
• He won a **gold medal** in the **Men’s Javelin Throw F64 category** at the **2020 Tokyo Paralympics.**
 
• Sumit set a **world record** during the event with a throw of **68.55 meters.**
 
 
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya**__
 
 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya is an Indian wrestler who competes in the **men's freestyle 57 kg category.**
 
• He won a **silver medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**, showcasing exceptional skill and determination.
 
• Ravi hails from **Sonipat, Haryana**, and is regarded as one of India's most promising young wrestlers.
